k-sym-MANDY.title: GTA 6 Mandy character coins
k-sym-MANDY.sourceSays: A post (104k views) says the character Mandy in GTA 6 is hotter than Lucia; other posts call $MANDY the memecoin of that game. The posts are claims, not verification.
k-sym-MANDY.reason: A Nov 18 15:12 post with large reach is about the game character Mandy, not the coin; the other coin posts are call-group shills. The oldest pool opened about 13.8h ago, so it may predate the post.
